items.title: Prompt-as-a-Protocol with Agentic Research Automation: A Validated Methodology for AI-Native Biomedical Data Science Producing Peer-Reviewed Findings Across Genomics and Biosensor Domains
items.abstract_or_text: Recent advances in large language model (LLM)-driven agentic systems have demonstrated capabilities for automating biomedical data analysis workflows. However, existing systems are predominantly validated on synthetic benchmarks or retrospective tasks, without demonstrated production of novel, peer-reviewed biological findings. Here we describe Prompt-as-a-Protocol (PaaP), a methodology that converts natural-language research questions into structured, executable analytical protocols, coupled with an agentic Generative Research Automation (GRA) layer that executes these protocols with integrated quality assurance. We validate PaaP+GRA through two prospective case studies in distinct biomedical domains. In single-cell transcriptomics, the pipeline identified KIF3A as the sole genome-wide significant correlate of ciliation status in human striatal parvalbumin interneurons (adjusted p = 1.37 x 10-14), while autonomously detecting and correcting a sex composition confound (p = 8.1 x 10-44) that would have produced spurious results. In biosensor analytics, the pipeline achieved calibrated PPG-to-ECG heart rate variability classification matching gold-standard ECG performance (ROC AUC = 0.85) for stress-state discrimination relevant to alcohol use disorder relapse monitoring. Both studies have been submitted for peer review. To our knowledge, PaaP+GRA is the first prompt-to-protocol methodology validated by prospective production of novel biological findings across multiple domains, including autonomous confound detection, rather than benchmark performance alone.
items.summary_zh: 提出 Prompt-as-a-Protocol（PaaP）与 Generative Research Automation（GRA）方法，把自然语言研究问题转为可执行分析协议，并在单细胞转录组和生物传感器两个前瞻性案例中验证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把生物医学智能体从合成基准推进到前瞻性数据分析，并展示了自动发现性别组成混杂和产出可检验生物学结果的能力；但两项研究仍已提交同行评审，尚非正式发表。
items.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）驱动的智能体系统近期已展现出自动化生物医学数据分析流程的能力。然而，现有系统主要在合成基准或回顾性任务上验证，尚未展示其能够产出新的、经过同行评审的生物学发现。我们介绍 Prompt-as-a-Protocol（PaaP），一种将自然语言研究问题转换为结构化、可执行分析协议的方法，并结合具有集成质量保证的智能体生成式研究自动化（GRA）层来执行这些协议。我们通过两个不同生物医学领域的前瞻性案例研究验证 PaaP+GRA。在单细胞转录组学中，该流程确定 KIF3A 是人类纹状体小清蛋白中间神经元纤毛状态的唯一全基因组显著相关因子（校正后 p = 1.37 x 10-14），同时自主检测并纠正了性别构成混杂（p = 8.1 x 10-44）；若不纠正，该混杂会产生虚假结果。在生物传感器分析中，该流程实现了经校准的 PPG 至 ECG 心率变异性分类，在与酒精使用障碍复发监测相关的压力状态判别中达到与金标准 ECG 相当的性能（ROC AUC = 0.85）。两项研究均已提交同行评审。据我们所知，PaaP+GRA 是首个通过跨多个领域前瞻性产出新的生物学发现来验证的提示词到协议方法，并且包括自主混杂检测，而不仅是基准性能。

items.title: Deep Survival Analysis: A Comprehensive Review of Methods, Applications, and Open Challenges in Biomedicine
items.abstract_or_text: Survival analysis is fundamental to biomedical research and clinical decision-making, where outcomes such as mortality, disease progression, relapse, and time-to-discharge are frequently observed under censoring and competing risks. Recent advances in deep learning have expanded the capabilities of survival modeling by enabling flexible nonlinear representations of heterogeneous biomedical data, including electronic health records, medical imaging, and multi-omics profiles. This structured narrative review synthesizes studies published between 2018 and 2026, examining major deep survival model families, including neural extensions of the Cox proportional hazards model, discrete-time and distribution-based approaches, multimodal architectures, transformers, and emerging foundation-model paradigms. We critically compare deep learning approaches with classical and machine learning survival methods, highlighting the conditions under which increased model complexity provides meaningful advantages. We further examine representative biomedical applications, datasets, evaluation and benchmarking practices, with particular emphasis on calibration, competing risks, external validation, and model selection. The review identifies persistent challenges in generalization, sample size and event scarcity, censoring mechanisms, interpretability, fairness, reproducibility, and clinical translation, while outlining emerging directions toward robust, trustworthy, and clinically actionable survival modeling systems.
items.summary_zh: 系统综述2018—2026年深度生存分析方法、应用、数据集与评估实践，覆盖 Cox 扩展、离散时间、分布式、多模态、Transformer 和基础模型范式。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 为生物医学时间结局建模提供方法谱系和评估框架，特别强调校准、竞争风险、外部验证、样本量、可解释性、公平性与临床转化限制。
items.abstract_zh: 生存分析是生物医学研究和临床决策的基础，因为死亡、疾病进展、复发和出院时间等结局经常在删失和竞争风险下被观察到。深度学习近期的发展通过对电子健康记录、医学影像和多组学谱等异质生物医学数据进行灵活的非线性表征，扩展了生存建模的能力。本结构化叙述性综述综合了2018年至2026年发表的研究，考察了主要的深度生存模型家族，包括 Cox 比例风险模型的神经网络扩展、离散时间方法和基于分布的方法、多模态架构、Transformer 以及新兴的基础模型范式。我们批判性地比较了深度学习方法与经典生存方法和机器学习生存方法，并强调模型复杂度增加在哪些条件下能够带来有意义的优势。我们还考察了具有代表性的生物医学应用、数据集、评估和基准实践，特别关注校准、竞争风险、外部验证和模型选择。该综述指出，泛化能力、样本量与事件稀少、删失机制、可解释性、公平性、可复现性以及临床转化仍存在持续挑战，同时提出面向稳健、可信和临床可行动生存建模系统的新兴方向。
items.author_line: Obaido G, Esenogho E, Nhlapho N

items.title: When Do Biological Reasoning Models Use Their Biological Inputs?
items.abstract_or_text: Biological reasoning models use post-training to connect LLMs to biological foundation model representations and biological text. Their benchmark accuracy is taken as evidence that LLMs reason over these inputs. We test this assumption in six biological reasoning models across DNA, protein, and single-cell tasks. We perturb one biological input while holding the query and other inputs fixed, construct evidence conflicts that pair the foundation model representation of one genome, protein, or cell with the text of another, fit linear probes to the representations the language model receives, and analyze reasoning traces against the biological inputs. Evo2 and ESM3 contribute little to BioReason and BioReason-Pro performance on the evaluated tasks. Shuffling the DNA sequence barely changes BioReason disease prediction accuracy, and in evidence conflicts the two models follow the text in 97.9% and 99.7% of cases. Linear probes trained on the Evo2 and ESM3 representations predict the task targets, so these foundation models encode information relevant to the task, but provide limited overall performance improvement to BioReason and BioReason-Pro. In contrast, foundation model inputs contribute to ChatNT, Prot2Text-V2, and CellWhisperer performance, and differentially expressed genes in the gene sentence contribute to Cell2Sentence-Scale performance. Across SFT and RL checkpoints of BioReason-Pro and 42 BioReason checkpoints, increases in accuracy do not imply greater performance contributions from biological inputs. BioReason traces misstate nucleotide changes, while BioReason-Pro traces describe functions omitted from final predictions under evidence conflicts. We find that current post-training strategies do not ensure that foundation model representations contribute to task performance.
items.summary_zh: 对六种生物推理模型在 DNA、蛋白质和单细胞任务中的输入依赖进行扰动、证据冲突、线性探针和推理轨迹审计，发现部分模型的生物基础模型输入对性能贡献很小。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它直接检验模型是否真正使用生物学输入，揭示基准准确率提升不等于生物输入贡献增加，为生物基础模型与 LLM 的组合评估提供了可复用审计范式。
items.abstract_zh: 生物推理模型通过后训练将 LLM 与生物基础模型表征及生物学文本连接起来。人们通常将其基准准确率视为 LLM 对这些输入进行推理的证据。我们在 DNA、蛋白质和单细胞任务上测试了六种生物推理模型的这一假设。我们在固定查询及其他输入的同时扰动一个生物学输入，构造证据冲突，将一个基因组、蛋白质或细胞的基础模型表征与另一个对象的文本配对；我们还对语言模型接收的表征拟合线性探针，并针对生物学输入分析推理轨迹。Evo2 和 ESM3 对 BioReason 与 BioReason-Pro 在所评估任务上的性能贡献很小。打乱 DNA 序列几乎不改变 BioReason 的疾病预测准确率；在证据冲突中，两种模型分别在 97.9% 和 99.7% 的案例中遵循文本。在线性探针实验中，基于 Evo2 和 ESM3 表征训练的探针能够预测任务目标，说明这些基础模型编码了与任务相关的信息，但它们对 BioReason 和 BioReason-Pro 的整体性能提升有限。相比之下，基础模型输入有助于 ChatNT、Prot2Text-V2 和 CellWhisperer 的性能，基因句子中的差异表达基因有助于 Cell2Sentence-Scale 的性能。在 BioReason-Pro 的 SFT 和 RL 检查点以及42个 BioReason 检查点中，准确率上升并不意味着生物输入的性能贡献增加。BioReason 的推理轨迹错误描述了核苷酸变化，而 BioReason-Pro 的轨迹在证据冲突下描述了最终预测中省略的功能。我们发现，当前的后训练策略并不能确保基础模型表征对任务性能作出贡献。

items.title: An automated, explainable, NCCT-based clinical decision-support system for spontaneous intracerebral hemorrhage.
items.abstract_or_text: Background: Spontaneous intracerebral hemorrhage (ICH) has high disability and mortality. Accurate early prognostication remains challenging in routine practice. Conventional CT assessment relies mainly on hematoma volume and rough anatomical location, limiting individualized prognosis. Radiomics combined with machine learning may improve prognostic assessment by extracting quantitative texture and heterogeneity features. Methods: In this retrospective multicenter study, we included 2,680 consecutive patients with spontaneous ICH: training (n=1,876), internal validation (n=804), and independent external validation (n=196). Deep learning automatically segmented hematomas, and 1,690 radiomics features were extracted from admission non-contrast CT (NCCT). After reproducibility assessment, univariate screening, and LASSO selection, 42 features were integrated into a Rad-score. The Rad-score was combined with demographic, clinical, and conventional CT variables to construct two complementary machine learning models for functional outcome prediction and comprehensive prognostic stratification. Performance was assessed using R 2 , mean squared error (MSE), area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC), calibration, decision curve analysis, and external validation. Both models were internally and externally validated. Ambient temperature variation at symptom onset was explored as a potential prognostic modifier. Results: Forty-two reproducible radiomics features constituted the Rad-score. Adding radiomics substantially improved performance over conventional clinical and imaging models. For functional outcome prediction, the integrated model increased R 2 from 0.35 to 0.93 and reduced MSE from 387 to 61. For prognostic risk stratification, the clinical-only model achieved an AUC of 0.59, whereas the fully integrated model achieved 0.95 and maintained robust external performance (AUC=0.86). Conclusions: We developed and validated a machine learning-based clinical decision support system integrating conventional CT radiomics and clinical variables for prognostic prediction and risk stratification in ICH. By capturing quantitative imaging information beyond conventional CT markers, this framework improved prognostic discrimination and generalizability. These findings support integrating quantitative imaging biomarkers into clinical decision-making for spontaneous ICH. The association between ambient temperature variation and disease progression warrants prospective investigation. Further prospective validation is warranted.
items.summary_zh: 基于2680例自发性脑出血多中心队列和 NCCT 放射组学，构建并外部验证可解释临床决策支持系统，预测功能结局并进行预后分层。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 数据规模、独立外部验证和影像组学增益较突出；但研究为回顾性预印本，环境温度与疾病进展的关系仍仅是待前瞻性验证的关联。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：自发性脑出血（ICH）具有很高的致残率和死亡率。准确的早期预后判断在常规实践中仍然具有挑战性。传统 CT 评估主要依赖血肿体积和粗略的解剖位置，限制了个体化预后判断。影像组学结合机器学习可能通过提取定量纹理和异质性特征来改善预后评估。方法：在这项回顾性多中心研究中，我们纳入了2680例连续的自发性 ICH 患者：训练集（n=1,876）、内部验证集（n=804）和独立外部验证集（n=196）。深度学习自动分割血肿，并从入院时的无造影剂 CT（NCCT）中提取1,690个影像组学特征。在进行可重复性评估、单变量筛选和 LASSO 选择后，将42个特征整合为 Rad-score。Rad-score 与人口学、临床和传统 CT 变量结合，构建了两个互补的机器学习模型，用于功能结局预测和综合预后分层。性能通过 R 2、均方误差（MSE）、受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）、校准、决策曲线分析和外部验证进行评估。两个模型均进行了内部和外部验证。我们还探索了症状发生时环境温度变化作为潜在预后修饰因素。结果：42个可重复的影像组学特征构成 Rad-score。加入影像组学后，模型性能相较传统临床和影像模型显著提高。对于功能结局预测，整合模型将 R 2 从0.35提高到0.93，并将 MSE 从387降低到61。在预后风险分层中，仅临床模型的 AUC 为0.59，而完全整合模型的 AUC 达到0.95，并在外部验证中保持稳健性能（AUC=0.86）。结论：我们开发并验证了一个基于机器学习的临床决策支持系统，将传统 CT 影像组学与临床变量整合，用于 ICH 的预后预测和风险分层。通过捕捉超出传统 CT 标志物的定量影像信息，该框架改善了预后区分能力和泛化能力。这些发现支持将定量影像生物标志物整合进自发性 ICH 的临床决策。环境温度变化与疾病进展之间的关联仍需前瞻性研究。仍需进一步的前瞻性验证。

items.title: OpenMTB-Audit: Exposing Over-Refusal and Clinical Expert Perspectives in LLM-Based Molecular Tumor Board Safety Evaluation
items.abstract_or_text: Molecular tumor boards integrate genomic findings, clinical context, and therapeutic evidence to support precision oncology. As AI enters this workflow, a key safety challenge is distinguishing truly unsupported recommendations from evidence-supported options that still require oncologist review because of incomplete information, poor ECOG performance status, or other clinical caveats. We introduce OpenMTB-Audit, an open-source benchmark of 500 synthetic non-small cell lung cancer cases spanning five adversarial error categories and four safety labels: Supported, Partially Supported, Unsupported, and Insufficient Information. Across eight large language model configurations, we identify pervasive over-refusal: all LLM configurations failed to retain the Partially Supported label in 83.3-100% of true Partially Supported cases, achieving high aggregate safety scores through label collapse rather than clinically calibrated reasoning. To address this limitation, we developed MTB-AuditAgent, a deterministic seven-module framework separating evidence verification, missing-information detection, safety classification, and abstention. It reduces over-refusal to 6.7% and achieves 91.2% accuracy (95% CI: 88.6-93.6%). A two-oncologist annotation study found disagreement concentrated at the boundary between information sufficiency and treatment optimization, underscoring the need to preserve clinically meaningful distinctions.
items.summary_zh: 发布包含500个合成非小细胞肺癌病例的 OpenMTB-Audit 基准，并提出七模块确定性 MTB-AuditAgent，评估分子肿瘤委员会场景中的过度拒答与安全分类。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 显示 LLM 可能通过把部分支持和信息不足病例一律拒答来获得虚高安全分，提出的模块化框架降低过度拒答并保留临床边界信息。
items.abstract_zh: 分子肿瘤委员会整合基因组发现、临床背景和治疗证据，以支持精准肿瘤学。随着 AI 进入这一工作流程，一个关键安全挑战是区分真正缺乏支持的建议与有证据支持但仍需肿瘤科医生复核的选项，后者可能因信息不完整、ECOG 体能状态较差或其他临床注意事项而需要复核。我们提出 OpenMTB-Audit，这是一个包含500个合成非小细胞肺癌病例的开放源代码基准，涵盖五类对抗性错误和四种安全标签：支持、部分支持、不支持和信息不足。在八种大型语言模型配置中，我们发现普遍存在过度拒答：所有 LLM 配置在83.3—100%的真实部分支持病例中都无法保留“部分支持”标签，通过标签塌缩而不是经过临床校准的推理获得较高的总体安全分。为应对这一问题，我们开发了 MTB-AuditAgent，一个将证据核验、缺失信息检测、安全分类和拒答分离开的确定性七模块框架。它将过度拒答降低到6.7%，并达到91.2%的准确率（95% CI：88.6—93.6%）。两名肿瘤科医生的标注研究发现，分歧集中在信息充分性与治疗优化之间的边界，凸显了保留具有临床意义的区别的必要性。
items.author_line: Negin Ashrafi, Jia Luo, Stacey M. Frumm, Roxana Daneshjou

items.title: Rank-Preserving Alignment Enables Cross-platform Learning and Phenotyping for Single-Cell and Spatial Proteomics
items.abstract_or_text: Decades of antibody-based protein profiling have generated valuable cohorts across evolving cytometry, sequencing and spatial imaging platforms. Differences in marker coverage, signal scale and antibody performance hinder joint analysis and reuse of cohorts with long-term clinical follow-up. Widely used RNA-based integration methods prioritize shared embeddings rather than directly comparable protein measurements. To fill in the gap, we developed RAMP (Rank-preserving Alignment of Multi-platform Proteomics), an unsupervised framework that aligns shared proteins without cell-type annotations. It combines sample-specific anchoring and cross-platform cell matching with bounded monotone transformations. The corrected values retain each protein marker's expression order across cells within a sample. Across seven integration tasks, RAMP achieved the strongest overall balance of batch correction and cell-type preservation. RAMP also improved marker-threshold transfer while preventing expression-order reversals observed with some comparison methods. These reversals made cell types with originally high marker expression appear lower-expressing than other populations. Such overcorrection can mislead cell identification and protein comparisons, even when the integrated embedding shows improved dataset mixing. By preserving each marker's expression order within a sample, RAMP protects the relationships needed to interpret normalized protein measurements. To investigate whether better harmonized inputs improve downstream learning, we used linear, nearest-neighbor and small neural-network models as a controlled, small-scale testbed. This approach tests an input quality question relevant to proteomic foundation models without undertaking large-scale pretraining. Under matched supervision, RAMP improved cross-platform annotation across all three model families and improved missing-marker prediction over unaligned inputs. These gains demonstrate the value of harmonized inputs for predictive learning and motivate evaluating RAMP as preprocessing for proteomic foundation models. In bone marrow, we used high-quality single-cell protein measurements to impute the failed CODEX CD19 channel, recovering B-cell spatial distributions. The completed panel improved B-cell separation from natural killer cells in the joint embedding. In melanoma, a proliferating CD8 T-cell state near tumor cells was associated with longer survival. Transfer such a spatial information to CITE-seq connected tumor proliferation and infiltration state to an adhesion and activation program involving PD-1, LFA-1 and CD2. In lung cancer, we used single-cell CyTOF measurements to predict unmeasured HLA-ABC states in vascular cancer-associated fibroblasts profiled by spatial imaging mass cytometry (IMC). Higher predicted scores were associated with lower immune-cell fractions and worse disease-free survival in the IMC cohort. In head and neck cancer, transferring a fibroblast/macrophage spatial niche score to CITE-seq identified a CD39/TIGIT-associated CD8 T-cell phenotype. Protein and RNA profiles supported checkpoint-associated features, and transfer back to CODEX showed correspondence with measured LAG3. RAMP enables existing single-cell and spatial cohorts to support new discoveries by connecting molecular programs, tissue organization and clinical outcomes across platforms.
items.summary_zh: 提出无监督 RAMP 框架，在不同细胞和空间蛋白质组平台间对齐共享蛋白，同时保持样本内蛋白表达排序，并在多癌种队列中用于标注迁移、缺失标志物预测和空间表型转移。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 解决跨平台蛋白测量不可直接比较和过度校正问题，覆盖七项整合任务并连接多种临床队列；其中癌症生存关联仍应理解为观察性关联。
items.abstract_zh: 数十年来，基于抗体的蛋白质谱分析在不断演进的流式细胞术、测序和空间成像平台上产生了有价值的队列。标志物覆盖范围、信号尺度和抗体性能的差异，阻碍了具有长期临床随访的队列的联合分析和再利用。广泛使用的基于 RNA 的整合方法优先考虑共享嵌入，而不是直接可比较的蛋白质测量。为填补这一空白，我们开发了 RAMP（Rank-preserving Alignment of Multi-platform Proteomics），一种无需细胞类型注释即可对齐共享蛋白的无监督框架。它结合样本特异性锚定、跨平台细胞匹配和有界单调变换。校正后的数值保留了每个样本内各细胞之间每个蛋白标志物的表达顺序。在七项整合任务中，RAMP 在批次校正和细胞类型保持之间取得了最强的总体平衡。RAMP 还改善了标志物阈值迁移，同时避免了某些比较方法观察到的表达顺序反转。这些反转会使原本标志物表达较高的细胞类型看起来比其他群体表达更低。即使整合嵌入显示出更好的数据集混合，这种过度校正也会误导细胞识别和蛋白质比较。通过保持每个样本内每个标志物的表达顺序，RAMP 保护了解释归一化蛋白质测量所需的关系。为研究更好的协调输入是否能改善下游学习，我们使用线性模型、最近邻模型和小型神经网络作为受控的小规模测试平台。这种方法检验了与蛋白质组基础模型相关的输入质量问题，而没有开展大规模预训练。在监督条件匹配时，RAMP 改善了三类模型的跨平台注释，并改善了相较未对齐输入的缺失标志物预测。这些增益展示了协调输入对预测学习的价值，并促使人们评估 RAMP 作为蛋白质组基础模型预处理步骤的作用。在骨髓中，我们使用高质量单细胞蛋白质测量来插补失败的 CODEX CD19 通道，恢复 B 细胞的空间分布。补全后的面板在联合嵌入中改善了 B 细胞与自然杀伤细胞的分离。在黑色素瘤中，肿瘤细胞附近的增殖性 CD8 T 细胞状态与更长的生存期相关。将这一空间信息转移到 CITE-seq 后，肿瘤增殖和浸润状态与涉及 PD-1、LFA-1 和 CD2 的黏附及激活程序相联系。在肺癌中，我们使用单细胞 CyTOF 测量来预测空间成像质谱（IMC）所分析的血管癌相关成纤维细胞中未测量的 HLA-ABC 状态。在 IMC 队列中，预测得分较高与较低的免疫细胞比例和较差的无病生存相关。在头颈癌中，将成纤维细胞/巨噬细胞空间生态位得分转移到 CITE-seq，识别出一种与 CD39/TIGIT 相关的 CD8 T 细胞表型。蛋白质和 RNA 谱支持检查点相关特征，转移回 CODEX 后与实测 LAG3 相对应。RAMP 使现有的单细胞和空间队列能够通过连接分子程序、组织组织和临床结局来支持新的发现。

items.title: A kinetic-aware approach to infer metabolic variations and flux using transcriptomics and metabolomics data
items.abstract_or_text: Assessing metabolic variations and flux quantities enable systematic understandings of metabolic shifts, reprogramming, adaptation and interactions in human diseases. However, omics-based estimation of metabolic flux and its variation remains challenging due to several fundamental limitations: the need for disease and tissue context specific metabolic model; nonlinear enzyme kinetic model that links enzyme and substrate changes to reaction flux; partial, unpaired, and snap-shot measurements across omics modalities; and uncertainty in computational prediction. Here, we present Michaelis-Menten model-based Flux Estimation Analysis (mmFEA), a Monte Carlo framework for estimating condition-specific flux changes by integrating paired or unpaired metabolomics and transcriptomics (or proteomics) data. mmFEA separates each reaction-rate change into enzyme- and substrate-associated components and assess reaction rate using Michaelis-Menten kinetics equation. A baseline metabolite saturation rate is introduced by integrating protein language model predicted kinetic parameters and human baseline level metabolic concentration to enable kinetic-aware integration of unpaired substrate and enzyme level measurements. Distribution of metabolic flux and variations between conditions are further computed using MCMC sampling by treating Michaelis-Menten-derived marginal flux distribution as prior and coherency in flux balance as likelihood. To benchmark mmFEA, we generated an in-house multi-omics data set including transcriptomics, metabolomics, metabolic activity functional assay, and CRISPR screening data using pancreatic cancer cell line system treated by APEX1 inhibitors. We demonstrated that mmFEA could accurately capture experimentally observed metabolic changes and achieved a better performance than all baseline methods. Our analysis revealed the necessity in using both substrate and enzyme modality and kinetic aware model in metabolic flux assessment. Further analysis using independent pancreatic cancer cohorts further validated the robustness of mmFEA, supporting integration of condition-linked unpaired data. Pan-cancer and spatial multi-omic applications demonstrated the use of mmFEA for resolving context-dependent metabolic variation when direct flux measurements are unavailable. Together, mmFEA provides a mechanistically grounded framework for estimating relative metabolic flux changes and their uncertainty from heterogeneous omics data.
items.summary_zh: 提出基于 Michaelis-Menten 的 mmFEA Monte Carlo 框架，整合转录组、代谢组或蛋白质组以估计条件特异性代谢通量，并在胰腺癌细胞系、独立队列、泛癌和空间多组学中验证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把酶和底物变化、动力学参数与通量平衡结合起来，较基线方法更贴近机制，并以功能实验和 CRISPR 筛选提供了外部支撑。
items.abstract_zh: 评估代谢变化和通量量值有助于系统理解人类疾病中的代谢转变、重编程、适应和相互作用。然而，基于组学估计代谢通量及其变化仍受到若干基本限制：需要疾病和组织背景特异的代谢模型；将酶和底物变化与反应通量联系起来的非线性酶动力学模型；不同组学模态之间部分、不配对且为瞬时测量的数据；以及计算预测中的不确定性。在此，我们提出基于 Michaelis-Menten 模型的通量估计分析（mmFEA），一种通过整合配对或不配对的代谢组与转录组（或蛋白质组）数据来估计条件特异性通量变化的 Monte Carlo 框架。mmFEA 将每个反应速率变化分解为酶相关和底物相关成分，并使用 Michaelis-Menten 动力学方程评估反应速率。通过整合蛋白质语言模型预测的动力学参数与人类基线代谢物浓度，我们引入基线代谢物饱和率，以支持对不配对底物和酶水平测量的动力学感知整合。随后将代谢通量及其在不同条件间的变化分布通过 MCMC 抽样计算，把由 Michaelis-Menten 得到的边际通量分布作为先验，并把通量平衡的一致性作为似然。为对 mmFEA 进行基准测试，我们在接受 APEX1 抑制剂处理的胰腺癌细胞系系统中生成了一个内部多组学数据集，包括转录组学、代谢组学、代谢活性功能实验和 CRISPR 筛选数据。我们证明，mmFEA 能够准确捕捉实验观察到的代谢变化，并且性能优于所有基线方法。我们的分析显示，在代谢通量评估中同时使用底物和酶两种模态以及采用动力学感知模型是必要的。进一步使用独立的胰腺癌队列分析验证了其稳健性，支持整合与条件相关的不配对数据。泛癌和空间多组学应用展示了在缺乏直接通量测量时解析背景依赖性代谢变化的用途。总之，mmFEA 提供了一个具有机制基础的框架，可从异质组学数据及其不确定性中估计相对代谢通量变化。

items.title: Assessing AI and Neurologist Diagnostic Reasoning Against Neuropathological Ground Truth
items.abstract_or_text: BACKGROUND Accurate differential diagnosis of complex neurological disorders remains challenging due to overlapping clinical features and heterogeneous disease presentations. Although large language models (LLMs) show promise in clinical reasoning, prior studies have benchmarked performance against clinician consensus rather than biological ground truth. Evaluation of diagnostic AI in neurology requires benchmarks grounded in neuropathological findings. METHODS We introduce NeuroBench, a curated benchmark of complex neurological cases with neuropathologically confirmed reference-standard diagnoses, and DIAGNO, a confidence-aware LLM-based system for neurological diagnosis. NeuroBench comprises 791 retrospective case summaries and corresponding autopsy-confirmed diagnoses across three independent health systems: 500 cases from the Massachusetts General Hospital (MGH) Brain Cutting Conference; 200 cases from the Mount Sinai Health System; and 91 cases from the University of Texas Health Science Center at San Antonio (UTHSA). Across all cases, DIAGNO generated top-3 differential diagnoses, employing retrieval-augmented generation for lower-confidence cases. In a subset of 203 complex MGH cases, performance was assessed by three independent blinded adjudicators who evaluated both DIAGNO and neurologists against neuropathological ground truth. RESULTS NeuroBench encompassed 59 unique neuropathological diagnoses, spanning conditions including cerebrovascular disease, brain tumors, neurological infections, and various neurodegenerative and inflammatory disorders. DIAGNO achieved 83.8% top-3 accuracy across the 500 MGH cases, 76.5% accuracy across the 200 Mount Sinai cases, and 92.3% accuracy across the 91 UTHSA cases. In the subset of 203 MGH cases, DIAGNO achieved higher top-3 accuracy (0.67 versus 0.63) and taxonomy-level accuracy (0.74 versus 0.67) than neurologists. In cases of disagreement, DIAGNO was more often correct than neurologists (29 versus 19 cases). Diagnostic concordance between DIAGNO and neurologists was high (90% agreement in top-3 predictions). In a real-world evaluation on eight cases from Mass General Brigham, neurologists rated DIAGNO's reasoning favorably (mean 4.03/5) across multiple dimensions. CONCLUSIONS NeuroBench establishes neuropathological confirmation as a reference standard for evaluating diagnostic AI in neurology, moving beyond clinician-based benchmarking to redefine the ceiling of diagnostic accuracy. Evaluated against this standard, DIAGNO achieved diagnostic performance comparable to neurologists and received favorable clinician ratings in real-world applications, supporting its potential as a clinical decision support tool in neurology.
items.summary_zh: 构建含791例尸检确诊神经系统病例的 NeuroBench，并评估具有检索增强和置信度感知的 DIAGNO 与神经科医生对神经病理学金标准的诊断表现。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 以神经病理学确诊而非医生共识作为参照，提升了临床 AI 评估的证据等级；结果支持其作为决策支持工具的潜力，但仍是回顾性预印本评估。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：复杂神经系统疾病的鉴别诊断仍然具有挑战性，因为临床特征存在重叠且疾病表现具有异质性。尽管大型语言模型（LLM）在临床推理方面显示出潜力，但既往研究通常以临床医生共识而非生物学金标准作为基准。神经科诊断 AI 的评估需要以神经病理学发现为基础的基准。方法：我们介绍 NeuroBench，一个包含复杂神经系统病例及神经病理学确诊参考诊断的整理基准；以及 DIAGNO，一个具有置信度感知的基于 LLM 的神经系统诊断系统。NeuroBench 包含791份回顾性病例摘要及相应的尸检确诊诊断，来自三个独立卫生系统：来自 Massachusetts General Hospital（MGH）脑切片会议的500例、来自 Mount Sinai Health System 的200例和来自 University of Texas Health Science Center at San Antonio（UTHSA）的91例。在所有病例中，DIAGNO 生成排名前3的鉴别诊断，并对低置信度病例采用检索增强生成。在203例复杂 MGH 病例的子集中，三名独立的盲法裁决者以神经病理学金标准为参照，评估 DIAGNO 和神经科医生的表现。结果：NeuroBench 包含59种独特的神经病理学诊断，涵盖脑血管病、脑肿瘤、神经系统感染以及各种神经退行性和炎症性疾病。在500例 MGH 病例中，DIAGNO 的排名前3准确率为83.8%；在 Mount Sinai 的200例中为76.5%；在 UTHSA 的91例中为92.3%。在203例 MGH 病例子集中，DIAGNO 的排名前3准确率（0.67 对0.63）和分类体系层级准确率（0.74 对0.67）均高于神经科医生。在意见不一致的病例中，DIAGNO 正确的次数多于神经科医生（29例对19例）。DIAGNO 与神经科医生的诊断一致性很高（排名前3预测的一致率为90%）。在真实世界对 Mass General Brigham 的8个病例评估中，神经科医生对 DIAGNO 推理的多维度评价良好（平均4.03/5）。结论：NeuroBench 建立了以神经病理学确诊为参考标准评估诊断 AI 的方法，超越基于临床医生的基准，并重新界定诊断准确率的上限。以这一标准评估时，DIAGNO 的诊断表现与神经科医生相当，并获得临床医生在真实世界应用中的良好评价，支持其作为神经科临床决策支持工具的潜力。

items.title: Generalizability of proteomic risk prediction across biobanks reveals dependence on phenotype definitions
items.abstract_or_text: Advances in high-throughput proteomics technologies have enabled the assessment of dynamic health states across biobank-scale cohorts. Disease prediction models built on these data have higher accuracy than baseline clinical models for a broad range of diseases, and provide avenues to understand disease pathogenesis. However, the generalizability of these prediction models across cohorts has yet to be established at scale. Here, we train models for 15 diseases in the UK Biobank (UKB; n=53,026) based on Olink proteomics data, and find high accuracy for disease prediction (mean AUC=0.74; range 0.56-0.89). These models have improved accuracy over models using only clinical factors (mean {Delta}AUC = 0.03), and do not depend on model architecture, with simpler models (e.g. L2) performing as well as complex models (e.g. transformer). We assess generalizability of the UKB-trained models in two external cohorts: FinnGen (FG; n=5,865) and All of Us (AoU; n=7,405), spanning two Olink platforms. We find that proteomics-based prevalent (classification) and incident (prediction over next 5 years) disease models largely generalize across cohorts, but performance varies across diseases. Specifically, 10 of 14 prevalent and 13 of 15 incident disease models show no significant decrease in performance across any biobank. Adjusting for demographic, ancestry, and technical covariates, we demonstrate that differences in phenotyping quality are likely the major drivers of variability across cohorts. These results indicate that proteomic risk models can be powerful and generalizable predictors of disease across multiple cohorts.
items.summary_zh: 在 UK Biobank 的 Olink 蛋白质组数据上训练15种疾病风险模型，并在 FinnGen 和 All of Us 两个外部生物样本库、两种 Olink 平台上检验跨队列泛化。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 大规模外部验证显示多数蛋白质组风险模型可迁移，表型定义质量比模型架构更可能解释跨队列性能差异，为临床部署和可复现性提供了关键警示。
items.abstract_zh: 高通量蛋白质组技术使人们能够在生物样本库规模的队列中评估动态健康状态。基于这些数据构建的疾病预测模型在广泛疾病上比基线临床模型具有更高准确率，并为理解疾病发病机制提供了途径。然而，这些预测模型在不同队列之间的泛化能力尚未在大规模范围内得到确立。在 UK Biobank（UKB；n=53,026）中，我们基于 Olink 蛋白质组数据为15种疾病训练模型，发现疾病预测准确率较高（平均 AUC=0.74；范围0.56—0.89）。与仅使用临床因素的模型相比，这些模型的准确率有所提高（平均 ΔAUC = 0.03），且不依赖模型架构，较简单的模型（例如 L2）表现与复杂模型（例如 transformer）相当。我们在两个外部队列中评估 UKB 训练模型的泛化能力：FinnGen（FG；n=5,865）和 All of Us（AoU；n=7,405），覆盖两个 Olink 平台。我们发现，基于蛋白质组的患病率（分类）和发病率（未来5年预测）疾病模型总体上可以跨队列泛化，但不同疾病之间的表现存在差异。具体而言，14个患病率模型中的10个和15个发病率模型中的13个，在任何生物样本库中都没有出现具有统计学意义的性能下降。在校正人口学、祖源和技术协变量后，我们证明表型定义质量的差异可能是队列间变异的主要驱动因素。这些结果表明，蛋白质组风险模型可以成为跨多个队列的强大且具有泛化能力的疾病预测器。

items.title: KRAS inhibition drives adaptive surfaceome remodeling and reveals ALPP/ALPPL2 as a targetable vulnerability in pancreatic cancer
items.abstract_or_text: KRAS is mutated in over 90% of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) and is required for tumor initiation and maintenance. While clinical trials testing mutant-selective and pan-RAS inhibitors (KRASi) have demonstrated significant clinical benefit, genetic and non-genetic mechanisms of resistance limit the long-term efficacy of monotherapy strategies. Here, we used quantitative temporal analysis of the global, phosphorylation, and surface proteome to comprehensively identify non-genetic adaptive pathways and cell surface biomarkers in response to acute and long-term KRAS inhibition in PDAC. Through integrative machine learning analysis of the KRASi-proteome and publicly available datasets, we discovered top priority cell surface targets for combination therapy with KRASi. We identified Placental Alkaline Phosphatase (ALPP) as upregulated in response to KRASi through compensatory JAK2/STAT3 signaling. We developed a novel clinical grade ALPP/ALPPL2 (ALPG)-targeting antibody drug conjugate (ADC) with site-specific MMAE conjugation and demonstrated single agent efficacy in PDAC models, as well as enhanced internalization and anti-tumor efficacy in combination with KRASi. Together, these studies comprehensively define the KRASi-induced proteome and identify ALPP/ALPPL2 as a promising cell surface target for combination with KRASi to enhance response and forestall KRASi resistance.
items.summary_zh: 通过时间分辨的全局、磷酸化和表面蛋白质组整合机器学习，解析 KRAS 抑制后的适应性表面组重塑，并开发靶向 ALPP/ALPPL2 的临床级抗体药物偶联物。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将蛋白质组机制分析与药物开发连接起来，在 PDAC 模型中显示单药和 KRAS 抑制联用活性；这些结果仍需独立和临床验证。
items.abstract_zh: KRAS 在超过90%的胰腺导管腺癌（PDAC）中发生突变，并且对肿瘤起始和维持是必需的。尽管针对突变型 KRAS 和泛 RAS 的抑制剂（KRASi）临床试验已显示出显著临床获益，但遗传和非遗传性耐药机制限制了单药策略的长期疗效。在此，我们对 PDAC 中急性和长期 KRAS 抑制响应进行了全局蛋白质组、磷酸化蛋白质组和表面蛋白质组的定量时间分析，以全面识别非遗传性适应通路和细胞表面生物标志物。通过整合 KRASi-蛋白质组数据与公开数据集，我们发现了 KRASi 联合治疗的优先细胞表面靶点。我们发现，胎盘碱性磷酸酶（ALPP）通过代偿性 JAK2/STAT3 信号在 KRASi 响应中上调。我们开发了一种新型临床级 ALPP/ALPPL2（ALPG）靶向抗体药物偶联物（ADC），采用位点特异性 MMAE 偶联，并在 PDAC 模型中证明其单药疗效；与 KRASi 联用时，增强了内化和抗肿瘤疗效。总之，这些研究全面定义了 KRASi 诱导的蛋白质组，并确定 ALPP/ALPPL2 是一个有希望与 KRASi 联用的细胞表面靶点，有望增强反应并延缓 KRASi 耐药。

items.title: Deep learning models detect neuromuscular disease and quantify functional impairment from video-derived biomechanics data
items.abstract_or_text: Measurements of human movement are critical for evaluating patients with neuromuscular diseases. However, current clinical tools are limited in sensitivity and can fail to detect the full spectrum of movement changes patients may exhibit. These limitations can obscure early signs of decline, delaying interventions that could preserve function and independence. OpenCap, a smartphone application that performs video-based markerless motion capture, can help address this gap by enabling scalable, out-of-lab measurements of human movement. Here, we present a method for both detecting disease and quantifying the severity of impaired movement from smartphone videos of patient motion. We used OpenCap to measure kinematics from 337 individuals with diagnoses spanning 12 rare, genetically-defined neuromuscular diseases and 78 age-matched healthy controls. Our dataset is the largest existing publicly available resource of body segment kinematics for this class of diseases. These data were collected in neuromuscular clinics during regular clinic visits as well as at conferences and community events across the United States. We trained deep learning models on these kinematic time series to differentiate between participants with neuromuscular disease and controls (AUROC = 0.97 [0.93-1.00]). We also developed a movement impairment severity score that correlates with both participant ratings of their own functional abilities ({rho} = -0.81, p < 0.001) and existing clinical tests of movement capabilities such as run speed ({rho} = -0.83, p < 0.001). Our methods for detecting disease and deriving quantitative biomarkers of movement impairment from smartphone videos have the potential to complement clinical assessments, inform screening protocols, and improve clinical trial endpoints.
items.summary_zh: 利用 OpenCap 手机视频无标记运动捕捉，基于337名12种遗传性神经肌肉病患者和78名健康对照的运动学数据训练深度学习模型，检测疾病并量化功能受损。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 提供该类疾病目前最大的公开身体节段运动学资源，并将视频运动学与患者自评和临床运动测试联系起来，具有筛查和试验终点开发潜力。
items.abstract_zh: 人体运动的测量对于评估神经肌肉疾病患者至关重要。然而，现有临床工具的敏感性有限，可能无法检测患者可能表现出的全部运动变化。这些局限会掩盖功能下降的早期信号，延误能够维持功能和独立性的干预。OpenCap 是一款执行无标记运动捕捉的视频手机应用，可以通过实现可扩展的实验室外人体运动测量来帮助解决这一问题。在此，我们提出一种方法，利用患者运动视频检测疾病并量化运动受损严重程度。我们使用 OpenCap 测量了337名患者的运动学数据，这些患者被诊断患有12种罕见的遗传性神经肌肉疾病；另有78名年龄匹配的健康对照。我们的数据集是目前该类疾病中规模最大的公开身体节段运动学资源。这些数据在美国各地的神经肌肉专科诊所常规就诊期间以及会议和社区活动中采集。我们在这些运动学时间序列上训练深度学习模型，以区分神经肌肉疾病患者和对照（AUROC = 0.97 [0.93-1.00]）。我们还开发了一个运动受损严重程度评分，该评分与参与者对自身功能能力的评价（ρ = -0.81，p < 0.001）以及现有的运动能力临床测试（例如跑步速度；ρ = -0.83，p < 0.001）均相关。我们用于通过手机视频检测疾病并推导运动受损定量生物标志物的方法，有潜力补充临床评估、为筛查方案提供信息并改善临床试验终点。

items.title: Multi-omics approach to map a clinically diverse large cohort with homozygous founder RAG1 p.C176F variant among Old Order Mennonites
items.abstract_or_text: Partially preserved function of recombination-activating genes (RAG) 1 and 2 can be linked to divergent and hard-to-predict clinical and immunological phenotypes, even among close relatives. It is unclear how intrinsic RAG hypomorphism interacts with extrinsic environmental pressures to shape clinical trajectory. We dissect this phenomenon in a unique cohort of 18 Old Order Mennonite individuals with a novel missense founder RAG1 variant (p.C176F) with 25.8% recombinase activity of wild-type protein. After studying a myriad of markers, we demonstrate varying severity and progression of clinical disease (predominantly in females) that paralleled decline in CMV-specific immune competence, break in tolerance with hallmark presence of antibodies to IFN, a TH1/IFN{gamma}-driven inflammatory milieu with elevated serum markers (CXCL9/10), expansion of follicular helper T cells and clonal B cells enriched for autoreactive-prone VH4.34 B cell receptor. BCR and TCR repertoires carry the fingerprints of both extrinsic and RAG-driven intrinsic changes. Through this experiment of nature, our cohort demonstrated that partial RAG deficiency (pRD) is not a monolithic disease but the result of compounded RAG intrinsic and extrinsic events. Overall, this study uses multi-omics approaches to dissect the contribution of a hypomorphic RAG variant to variable severity of clinical disease and immunological dysregulation at cellular and molecular level. Emerging biomarkers of a multi-omic roadmap should allow monitoring of progression of clinical disease and guide who and when to treat with hematopoietic stem cell transplant in pRD.
items.summary_zh: 研究18名 Old Order Mennonite 人群中 RAG1 p.C176F 低功能变异，通过临床、单细胞免疫、代谢及 BCR/TCR 组学解析部分 RAG 缺陷的异质性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是一个独特的自然实验队列，连接遗传变异、免疫失衡和临床进展，并提出可用于监测和造血干细胞移植决策的多组学生物标志物路线。
items.abstract_zh: 重组激活基因 RAG1 和 RAG2 的部分保留功能可能与不同且难以预测的临床和免疫学表型相关，即使在近亲之间也是如此。目前尚不清楚内在的 RAG 低功能如何与外在环境压力相互作用以塑造临床轨迹。我们分析了一个独特的队列，其中18名 Old Order Mennonite 个体携带一种新的错义创始变异 RAG1 p.C176F；该变异具有野生型蛋白25.8%的重组酶活性。在研究多种标志物后，我们显示疾病严重程度和进展各不相同（主要见于女性），并与 CMV 特异性免疫能力下降、耐受性破坏以及 IFN 抗体的典型存在相一致；同时观察到 TH1/IFN{gamma} 驱动的炎症环境，血清 CXCL9/10 升高，滤泡辅助性 T 细胞和克隆性 B 细胞扩增，且后者富集具有自身反应倾向的 VH4.34 B 细胞受体。BCR 和 TCR 组库带有外在因素和 RAG 驱动内在变化的特征。通过这一自然实验，我们的队列显示，部分 RAG 缺陷（pRD）并非单一疾病，而是 RAG 内在因素与外在因素共同作用的结果。总体而言，本研究使用多组学方法，在细胞和分子层面剖析低功能 RAG 变异对疾病严重程度差异和免疫失调的影响。正在出现的多组学生物标志物路线图应有助于监测疾病进展，并指导 pRD 患者何时以及是否接受造血干细胞移植。

items.title: Protein Language Model-Conditioned Graph Neural Networks for Multitask GPCR Ligand Activity Prediction
items.abstract_or_text: Predicting ligand activity across G protein-coupled receptors (GPCRs) requires models that capture both molecular structure and receptor-specific information while remaining robust to chemical and target-domain shifts. We developed a multimodal graph neural network that combines explicit ligand molecular graphs with frozen protein language model representations of GPCR sequences and jointly predicts quantitative pActivity and binary activity. The model was trained on 271,739 curated ligand-GPCR pairs spanning 183,694 ligands and 216 human GPCRs and evaluated using random, Bemis-Murcko scaffold, and strict cold-ligand partitions. With ESM-2 650M receptor embeddings, the selected model achieved mean absolute errors of 0.513 ± 0.006, 0.540 ± 0.006, and 0.641 ± 0.005 pActivity units under random, cold-ligand, and scaffold evaluation, respectively, substantially outperforming a protein-aware fixed-feature multilayer perceptron and consistently improving quantitative prediction over a matched GINE reference. Removing receptor embeddings markedly degraded both regression and classification, whereas differences among ESM-2 35M, ESM-2 650M, and ProtT5 were comparatively small. Independent evaluation on 6,319 ChEMBL 37/BindingDB pairs revealed a substantial external domain shift, with mean absolute error increasing to approximately 0.94-0.95 despite chemically stringent internal validation. Nevertheless, receptor-specific information remained highly informative in a DRD2-DRD3 selectivity analysis: the cold-ligand ensemble achieved R^2 = 0.853, Spearman ρ = 0.916, and ROC-AUC = 0.966 for strong DRD3 selectivity, whereas the receptor-independent ablation approached chance-level discrimination. These results establish protein-language-model-conditioned molecular graph learning as a scalable strategy for GPCR bioactivity prediction while identifying chemotype novelty, external-domain transfer, and richer ligand-receptor interaction representations as key remaining challenges.
items.summary_zh: 构建融合配体分子图和冻结 GPCR 蛋白语言模型表示的多模态图神经网络，在27万余个配体—GPCR 配对上预测定量与二元活性，并检验冷配体、骨架和外部域迁移。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 显示受体序列表示对 GPCR 活性和选择性预测有增益，同时量化外部域偏移，避免将内部验证性能直接视为跨化学空间泛化。
items.abstract_zh: 预测 G 蛋白偶联受体（GPCR）的配体活性，需要模型同时捕捉分子结构和受体特异性信息，并且在化学空间和靶点域发生变化时保持稳健。我们开发了一种多模态图神经网络，将显式配体分子图与冻结的蛋白质语言模型 GPCR 序列表征结合起来，并联合预测定量 pActivity 和二元活性。模型在覆盖183,694种配体和216个人类 GPCR 的271,739个经整理的配体—GPCR 配对上训练，并采用随机、Bemis-Murcko 骨架和严格冷配体划分进行评估。使用 ESM-2 650M 受体嵌入时，所选模型在随机、冷配体和骨架评估下的平均绝对误差分别为0.513 ± 0.006、0.540 ± 0.006和0.641 ± 0.005个 pActivity 单位，显著优于基于蛋白质信息的固定特征多层感知器，并且在定量预测上始终优于匹配的 GINE 参考模型。移除受体嵌入会明显降低回归和分类性能，而 ESM-2 35M、ESM-2 650M 和 ProtT5 之间的差异相对较小。在包含6,319个 ChEMBL 37/BindingDB 配对的独立评估中，观察到显著的外部域偏移，平均绝对误差升高到约0.94—0.95。尽管如此，在 DRD2-DRD3 选择性分析中，受体特异性信息仍然非常有用：冷配体集成模型在强 DRD3 选择性判别中达到 R^2 = 0.853、Spearman ρ = 0.916 和 ROC-AUC = 0.966，而不依赖受体的消融模型接近随机水平。这些结果确立了蛋白质语言模型条件化分子图学习作为 GPCR 生物活性预测的可扩展策略，同时指出化学型新颖性、外部域迁移和更丰富的配体—受体相互作用表征仍是关键挑战。

items.title: A Lenalidomide-Inducible Suicide Switch for Gene- and Cell-Based Therapy
items.abstract_or_text: Genetically modified immune effector cells, including chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T cells, have emerged as transformative anti-cancer agents. However, these autonomous, living therapies are limited by difficult-to-control hyperactivation toxicities. To achieve their full potential as therapies for a broader range of diseases, CAR T cells must target novel antigens and integrate further potency enhancements that raise the possibility of novel and intensified toxicities. High performance safety systems are needed to restrain these highly active next-generation gene- and cell-based therapies. Cell therapy suicide switches remain infrequently used, and are currently limited by inaccessible controller drugs, incomplete cell depletion, fitness cost, and immunogenicity. To address these issues, we engineered a fully human sequence-based cell therapy suicide switch based on the overexpression of Caspase-Activated DNase (CAD) and its stoichiometric chaperone/inhibitor ICAD fused to a lenalidomide-inducible degron. Acute destabilization of ICAD with the broadly available, off-patent molecular glue degrader drug lenalidomide uncaged CAD to induce DNA damage and cell death. By this degradable cage mechanism, the ICAD-CAD suicide switch achieved long-term expression in primary human T cells without detectable leakiness, and deep drug-induced cell depletion. The ICAD-CAD switch was generalizable to alternative acute destabilization systems. Genome-wide CRISPR screening established the necessity of CAD and the lenalidomide-interacting E3 ubiquitin ligase substrate adaptor CRBN for switch function. When co-delivered with a CAR, ICAD-CAD CAR T cells retained effector functions and could be rapidly depleted with lenalidomide.
items.summary_zh: 设计基于 ICAD-CAD 和来那度胺诱导降解的全人源细胞治疗自杀开关，在原代人 T 细胞和 CAR-T 细胞中实现低泄漏表达及药物诱导清除。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 为高活性基因和细胞疗法提供可用的安全控制机制，并以全基因组 CRISPR 筛选验证 CAD 和 CRBN 对开关功能的必要性。
items.abstract_zh: 包括嵌合抗原受体（CAR）T 细胞在内的基因修饰免疫效应细胞，已经成为变革性抗癌药物。然而，这些自主的活细胞疗法受到难以控制的过度激活毒性的限制。为了使其能够用于更广泛的疾病，CAR T 细胞必须靶向新的抗原并整合更多增强效力的设计，这会增加出现新型且更严重毒性的可能性。需要高性能安全系统来约束这些高活性的下一代基因和细胞疗法。细胞疗法自杀开关的使用仍不普遍，目前受限于控制药物不可获得、细胞清除不完全、适应度代价和免疫原性。为解决这些问题，我们工程化构建了一种完全基于人源序列的细胞疗法自杀开关，其基础是过表达 Caspase-Activated DNase（CAD）及其化学计量伴侣/抑制因子 ICAD，并将 ICAD-CAD 与来那度胺诱导型降解标签融合。通过广泛可获得且已失去专利保护的分子胶降解剂来那度胺急性 destabilization ICAD，使 CAD 脱笼并诱导 DNA 损伤和细胞死亡。借助这种可降解笼机制，ICAD-CAD 自杀开关在原代人 T 细胞中实现长期表达且未检测到泄漏，并实现了深度的药物诱导细胞清除。该 ICAD-CAD 开关可推广到其他急性 destabilization 系统。全基因组 CRISPR 筛选证实，CAD 以及来那度胺相互作用的 E3 泛素连接酶底物适配蛋白 CRBN 对开关功能是必需的。当与 CAR 共递送时，ICAD-CAD CAR T 细胞保留效应功能，并可通过来那度胺快速清除。

items.title: Veillonella dispar triggers dual-hits in the pathogenesis of autoimmune hepatitis and primary biliary cholangitis via testosterone depletion-BAFF-B cell axis and Th17 cell activation
items.abstract_or_text: Objective: Autoimmune hepatitis (AIH) and primary biliary cholangitis (PBC) frequently present as overlap syndromes, characterized by shared sexual dimorphism and elevated intestinal Veillonella dispar (V. dispar) abundance, yet exhibiting distinct hallmark pathological manifestations. This study aimed to elucidate the shared pathogenesis, phenotypic differentiation mechanisms and sex-specific predisposition of AIH and PBC induced by V. dispar. Methods: Clean-grade and germ-free (GF) mice were employed to establish AIH and PBC models. Model induction involved oral gavage of V. dispar and intraperitoneal injection of either liver-specific antigen S100 (for AIH) or a pyruvate dehydrogenase complex E2 subunit (PDC-E2) mimetic peptide (for PBC). Single-cell RNA sequencing, metabolomics, transmission electron microscopy, western blotting, and flow cytometry were utilized to elucidate the underlying mechanisms. Results: V. dispar successfully induced autoimmune liver disease-like features in mice, characterized by significant intrahepatic B cell infiltration. Mechanistically, V. dispar caused systemic arginine reduction, leading to intrinsic apoptosis of gonadal stromal cells and a subsequent reduction in testosterone. This decreased testosterone weakened its inhibitory effect on B cell activating factor (BAFF) secretion, thereby amplifying B cell-mediated immune responses. Furthermore, in the presence of S100 or PDC-E2 mimetic peptide, V. dispar also facilitated Th17 cell activation, which guided the phenotypic differentiation into AIH or PBC, respectively. Consistent with these findings, our clinical observations revealed that patients with AIH and PBC tended to harbor enriched V. dispar, along with lower serum arginine and testosterone. In addition, elevated serum levels of BAFF and IL-17 were also observed in these patients. Conclusion: V. dispar induces reduced testosterone levels and upregulation of BAFF, leading to intrahepatic B cell expansion, which serves as the common pathogenic basis for AIH and PBC. The presence of S100 and PDC-E2 subsequently drives further maturation of these expanded B cells and promotes Th17 cell activation, thereby determining the phenotypic divergence between AIH and PBC.
items.summary_zh: 在小鼠模型和临床观察中研究 Veillonella dispar 对自身免疫性肝炎与原发性胆汁性胆管炎的影响，提出精氨酸下降—睾酮下降—BAFF—B 细胞轴和 Th17 激活的双重机制模型。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 结合无菌小鼠、单细胞转录组、代谢组和患者观察，连接肠道菌、性别相关信号与自身免疫表型；机制链条仍应视为该研究支持的模型，不能替代因果临床证据。
items.abstract_zh: 目的：自身免疫性肝炎（AIH）和原发性胆汁性胆管炎（PBC）经常以重叠综合征形式出现，其特征包括共同的性别二态性和升高的肠道 Veillonella dispar（V. dispar）丰度，但两者又表现出不同的典型病理表现。本研究旨在阐明由 V. dispar 诱导的 AIH 和 PBC 的共同发病机制、表型分化机制和性别特异性易感性。方法：研究使用清洁级和无菌（GF）小鼠建立 AIH 和 PBC 模型。模型诱导包括灌胃 V. dispar，并分别腹腔注射肝脏特异性抗原 S100（用于 AIH）或丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体 E2 亚基（PDC-E2）模拟肽（用于 PBC）。研究采用单细胞 RNA 测序、代谢组学、透射电子显微镜、western blotting 和流式细胞术阐明潜在机制。结果：V. dispar 成功诱导了类似自身免疫性肝病的特征，其特点是肝内 B 细胞显著浸润。从机制上看，V. dispar 导致全身精氨酸减少，引起性腺基质细胞内在性凋亡，继而导致睾酮下降。睾酮下降减弱了其对 B 细胞活化因子（BAFF）分泌的抑制作用，从而放大了 B 细胞介导的免疫反应。此外，在 S100 或 PDC-E2 模拟肽存在时，V. dispar 还促进 Th17 细胞活化，引导表型向 AIH 或 PBC 分化。与此一致，我们的临床观察显示，AIH 和 PBC 患者往往具有更高的 V. dispar 丰度，同时血清精氨酸和睾酮较低。此外，这些患者的血清 BAFF 和 IL-17 水平也升高。结论：V. dispar 诱导睾酮水平降低和 BAFF 上调，导致肝内 B 细胞扩增，这构成共同的致病基础。随后 S100 和 PDC-E2 促使这些扩增的 B 细胞进一步成熟，并促进 Th17 细胞活化，从而决定表型分化。
